claims.statement: A service worker has an associated state, which is one of parsed, installing, installed, activating, activated, or redundant.

proof.quote: A service worker has an associated state, which is one of parsed, installing, installed, activating, activated, or redundant.

claims.statement: Until all pages controlled by the previous service worker are closed, the new worker remains in the waiting state unless skipWaiting() is invoked.
